note: DTN Content Services cash-bids-table-widget. Read from ONE call to https://api.dtn.com/markets/sites/e0030901/cash-bids?units=us — the site id e0030901 carries this location and its neighbours together, so every one of them is a source file and none of them is new code. IT IS READ THROUGH A BROWSER AND NOT BY A FETCH: DTN answered a server-side probe with "The api key is valid, but it is valid to be used within a browser only", so their gateway scopes these widget keys to browser use. poll.mjs loads https://fscooperatives.com/aglandfs/agriculture/cash-bids in a real Chromium and reads the response their own widget asks for, which means we hold no key at all — theirs is public in their page, as it must be for the widget to work. THE LOCATION KEY IS THE NUMERIC location.id (4205) AND NOT THE NAME: a display name is exactly the thing a vendor re-cases, and some of these names are companies rather than towns. cashRounding is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. One run said floor-cent (3 testable rows, margin 3) and there is no second run to agree with it. A mode is a property of how they compute their board, so it needs the same answer on a different day's prices. Left off, the identity guard stays exact and a board that does not reconcile refuses loudly instead of publishing under a mode nobody established. COORDINATES ARE NULL AND THAT IS DELIBERATE: the feed carries no coordinate, and a town centroid is a different place from a yard — measured at 1.4 miles on babgrain-auburn. Geocode the street address before relying on a map pin. Built by scripts/dtn-build.mjs from a dtn-probe log; 3 row(s) for this location. STILL DISABLED, AND THE REASON IS THE STATE. Ag-Land FS's own grain terminal page lists Elmwood, Green Valley, Williamsfield and Monica-Dunlap and does NOT list Alto. The name may be a facility rather than a town, or a rendering of a nearby place. Do not guess a state for it. Rule 1: do not invent a town or a state.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the feed their own website reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
